research_question: Can the complete ICT Market Maker Buy/Sell Model lifecycle, rather than an isolated entry pattern, produce repeatable Bybit USDT-linear after-cost NAV growth?
smc_ict_explanation: Original Consolidation creates both-side liquidity. Price then engineers a multi-leg delivery curve away from that origin, raids terminal external liquidity in deep premium or discount, confirms a Smart Money Reversal through CISD/MSS displacement, holds the reversal line on the first pullback, and delivers back to the frozen Original Consolidation and its opposite liquidity.

required_sequence: two or more directionally ordered engineered-liquidity shelves
terminal external-liquidity raid beyond the last confirmed pivot
deep excursion relative to the frozen Original Consolidation range
CISD/MSS displacement through the final engineered shelf
first pullback that holds the reversal line
delivery to the far boundary of the frozen Original Consolidation
not_used: isolated FVG, IFVG or BPR touch
fixed session or Silver Bullet window

data_contract.development_period: 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31, physically opened only after fit survivors are frozen
data_contract.gap_contract: A complete 5-minute grid is retained. Features and cycles reset at a missing or invalid bar; an accepted position encountering a source gap receives its structural stop outcome.

causal_contract.bar_availability: A bar is usable only after its close; entry is the next valid 5-minute open.
causal_contract.pivot_confirmation: A swing is available only after three completed bars to its right.
causal_contract.original_consolidation: Four or eight completed 60-minute bars, frozen before the engineering break.
causal_contract.same_bar_exit: Protective stop is evaluated before target.
causal_contract.target: The far boundary of the frozen Original Consolidation.
causal_contract.position_exit: Structural stop, frozen target, or source-gap structural-stop outcome only. No elapsed-time exit.
causal_contract.evaluation_boundary: An open position is marked at realistic liquidation value and flagged; it is not force-closed and cannot pass a gate.

development_rule: Only the four highest 18bps fit geometric-growth survivors are frozen. Their IDs and fit hashes are written before 2023 is downloaded. The same gate is then applied without changing any rule.
promotion_boundary: This 2022/2023 discovery sequence cannot enter the project ranking. Any development survivor requires a new sequential 2024-2026 claim with actual Bybit funding and exact BBO/depth execution.
